Now, at 85 years old, Anne sees a startling contrast between the world of giraffes she once knew and the one it has become. Weaving through the past and present, her harrowing journey gives us an intimate look into the factors that destroyed her career and the forces that brought her back.

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters
programme.desc: Kristina travels to the Mana Pools National Park with guide Craig van Zyl. They come across mating lions, have close encounters with bull elephants and canoe just meters away from imposing hippos and crocodiles on the mighty Zambezi River.

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters
programme.desc: Pamuzinda Safari Lodge is only one and a half hours from the capital - Harare. With Lawrence as her guide, Kristina embarks on an entertaining horse-back safari, interacts with Jasmine the giraffe, has a relaxing canoe trip and meets the clever resident elephant herd.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers. The cubs will have to trust their instincts, their mother and the power of the pride if they are to make it to adulthood and take their place on the African plains.

programme.title: Destination Wild
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Destination Wild
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next.

programme.title: Nature's Weirdest
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most – scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on. Each one finds its own way to exploit and conserve the available food and water in a daily struggle for survival.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S1 E02
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, the land with the highest density of population in the world (and the highest amount of corruption), the daily struggle to survive is fought everywhere, including the streets. Nowhere do people drive as brutally and recklessly as here. In Bangladesh you drive on the road like others drive with a bumper car: if you need space, you simply ram the car driving next to you. The police only came if there are fatalities. The biggest bottleneck in the transport system is the historical old town of Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a universe of its own, a world of bazaars in which every trade has its own quarter: there are streets of jewelers, sweets makers and fashionable tailors, and the vegetable wholesalers have their warehouses down at the port. The deliveries take place mostly on the river, the Buriganga River, a stinking cesspool. But the sold goods usually leave by land, and the customers also come by the land route – the Nawabpur Road. They generally come in buses or by rickshaw, where too many people are crammed into too little space. The traffic in Dhaka is everyday, normal madness. The film accompanies a rickshaw, a bus and a truck on their dangerous way through the streets of Dhaka and shows how it is possible to survive in what seems to be an incontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S1 E05
programme.desc: They run through deserts, through ice and snow, deep into the jungle, along the water and over the mountains. The landscapes through which these routes wind are unique and exert their never-ending fascination even on regular travellers. In our documentary “Hot Roads – An Icebound Road” which is part of the five-part film series “Hot Roads” we want to tell the stories that take place along the route itself, of the people who live along it and for whom the road is part and parcel of their personal destiny.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: The Provence coast
programme.desc: The Provence is famed for its endless fields of laven-der, but this lush landscape also has a beautifully mari-time touch: The Côte Bleue! Small, hidden beaches, charming harbour towns, imposing, craggy bays and a uniquely clear light that has attracted painters includ-ing Cézanne and Braque. The coast derives its name from the deep blue water and extends from Marseille to Martigues. This small town is also known as "The Ven-ice of the North", as it is shaped entirely by water: an inland lake, the sea itself, as well as a connecting canal. In the bays of the Calanques, the steeply-walled coastal inlets in the Mediterranean limestone, Lionel Franc is a cliff diver. His personal record is a hight of 36 metres! Ambi is a sculptress. This young artist's work, who moved to Marseille from Madagascar many years ago, is characterised by a dynamic momentum. As a pas-sionate pétanque player, she demonstrates this drive on the boules courts of the port city. John Pendray is Pein-tre officiel de la Marine, an official marine painter. The French state allows just 40 painters to its circle. There are no monetary rewards, but heaps of honour and a very smart uniform!

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard Depardieu and his wife Carole Bouquet bought to produce traditional liqueur and nutmeg wine themselves and distribute it worldwide. The cuisine of the island is as much Arabic as Italian, couscous with fish is a typical island dish.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF's Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly's ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky's own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly's horse wins the race. At Louisville's Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: A Myth Full Of Grief And Despair About One Historical Error
programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Umeed India

For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle
programme.desc: The history of the British Empire colonial legacy in Northern Ireland is well known the world over but a there is a largely untold story of the the firefights between and close quarter battles exchanged between the provisional IRA, the British army and the elite SAS. Although the IRA often employed „terrorist“ techniques within the city of London and on England‘s mainland not much is said of the often guerilla warfare techniques of the British Special Air Service in Northern Ireland since the beginning of this conflict. In this episode we will examine how the history of the Special Air Service affected the training of every elite force after it and how the close quarter battles in Northern Ireland in the late 1970s through to the millennium shaped both special forces and resistance methods.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Travel the world without ever leaving the kitchen! Intrepid host of CombiNATION Plates, Bianca Osbourne, starts this episode with Ethiopian inspired Berbere Spiced Quail, seared in aromatic Niter Kibbeh, and served with crunchy-sour Gomen Salad. Brazil is next, check out this re- invention of Feijoada... with braised and seared pork belly, oranges, crema, and fresh black bean salsa. Common ingredient 'Coffee and Sweets' is next... with java-spiked Injera Crepe Cake for Ethiopia and Brazil blending up a dark roast of rich, coffee-spiked, chocolatey Brigadeiros truffles. The final plate is Coconut Crusted Black Cod with cheesy Brazilian-style Pao de Queijo bites, and teff flour a brush of spiced ghee inspired by Ethiopia.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

Quando Regina inizia a mettergli pressione perché vuole avere un bambino, l'uomo si ammala e, raggiunto l'obiettivo, Regina inizierà a trascurarlo fino a causare un drammatico evento.

programme.title: Il Commissario Pepe

Ma proprio alla vigilia delle nozze, qualcuno gli ruba il cavallo. Nel giorno del suo matrimonio, il carabiniere farà di tutto per trovarlo. Diretta da Carlo Lizzani.

programme.title: I ragazzi dei Parioli

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Ciao maschio

programme.title: Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: Due terroristi entrano in un laboratorio dove si sperimentano armi batteriologiche prodotte dai servizi segreti e contraggono un terribile virus. Uno dei due riesce a fuggire e a salire sul treno per Stoccolma dove contagia alcuni passeggeri. Ma i servizi segreti rintracciano il convoglio e decidono di deviarlo verso la Polonia. Lo scopo è farlo precipitare su un ponte pericolante il Cassandra Crossing, in modo che tutti muoiano e si perdano le tracce del terribile segreto...

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Tre ragazze condividono un sogno: fare fortuna. Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: I'm not here

Collegando ciò che gli è capitato, cerca di scoprire come mai sia finito distrutto e da solo. Mentre rivive ogni significativo ricordo, capisce quali problemi generazionali lo hanno reso prigioniero, come accaduto a suo padre prima di lui. Potrà mai superare il dolore, perdonare chi gli ha fatto del male, e cosa più importante, trovare pace con se stesso?

programme.title: Final Portrait
programme.desc: Nel 1964, durante un breve viaggio a Parigi, lo scrittore americano e appassionato d'arte James Lord incontra il suo amico Alberto Giacometti, un pittore di fama internazionale, che gli chiede di posare per lui. Le sedute, gli assicura Giacometti, dureranno solo qualche giorno. Lusingato e incuriosito, Lord accetta. Non è solo l'inizio di un'amicizia insolita e toccante, ma anche di un viaggio illuminante nella bellezza, la frustrazione, la profondità e, a volte, il vero e proprio caos del processo artistico.

programme.title: I diari della motocicletta
programme.desc: Nel 1952, Ernesto Guevara e Alberto Granado attraversano l'America Latina in motocicletta. Il viaggio, nato come avventura, diventa una scoperta delle ingiustizie sociali che cambierà per sempre il loro destino. Uno di loro diventerà il leggendario Che.

programme.title: La ragazza senza nome
programme.desc: Una sera, a fine giornata, Jenny, una giovane dottoressa, sente suonare alla porta, ma non risponde. Il giorno dopo, la polizia la informa che una donna ancora non identificata è stata trovata morta nelle vicinanze.

programme.title: LARS E UNA RAGAZZA TUTTA SUA
programme.desc: Lars è un uomo estremamente timido e isolato che sorprende tutti presentando una bambola come la propria fidanzata. La comunità sceglie di assecondarlo in un percorso inatteso di crescita e guarigione emotiva.

programme.title: OSSESSIONE PERICOLOSA
programme.desc: Laure vede la sua vita cambiare in poco tempo: sospesa dal lavoro, problemi con la custodia della figlia della sua migliore amica e in pericolo di vita per colpa di un falso pettegolezzo

programme.title: L'AMORE NON SI IMPARA
programme.desc: La PR Elizabeth ha una nuova sfida da affrontare: occuparsi di sua nipote Ruby e salvare la scuola. Cosa guadagna? Jamie, ex broker e maestro della scuola, si trasforma in babysitter

programme.title: Falsa identità
programme.desc: Il sospetto di Melanie si rivela corretto quando scopre che il gemello identico di suo marito sta vivendo con lei fingendo di essere suo marito, mettendo in pericolo le loro vite con i suoi piani sinistri.

programme.title: CHE VINCA IL MIGLIORE
programme.desc: Quando il fidanzato di Tiffany annulla il matrimonio, lei rimane con il cuore spezzato... il matrimonio dei suoi sogni è saltato. A peggiorare le cose, la sua migliore amica-nemica al lavoro sembra accaparrarsi tutte le cancellazioni per il proprio matrimonio.

programme.title: AFTER THE DARK
programme.desc: Un misterioso professore di filosofia sfida la sua classe. Utilizzando il solo potere della logica, dovranno scegliere chi tra loro sarebbe degno di un posto in un rifugio sotterraneo costruito per resistere a un'apocalisse nucleare.

programme.title: LErba Di Grace
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di salvare la sua proprietà, Grace, una vedova inglese, decide di collaborare con un giardiniere e trasformare la serra di orchidee in una coltivazione di marijuana.

programme.title: Bello Onesto Emigrato Australia Sposerebbe Compaesana Illibata
programme.desc: Bellissima commedia con Alberto Sordi e Claudia Cardinale. Un operaio emigrato in Australia cerca moglie per corrispondenza usando la foto di un amico. Lo raggiunge, senza rivelarsi, una ex prostituta. Le reciproche bugie creano divertenti malintesi.

programme.title: Megalodon
programme.desc: Una nave della marina americana alla ricerca di un sommergibile russo non identificato si trova faccia a faccia con uno squalo gigante. L'equipaggio si trova costretto a difendersi dalla mostruosa bestia.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Il veterano del Corpo dei Marines Jed Eckert (Chris Hemsworth) e suo fratello Matt fuggono con un gruppo di amici in una baita isolata nel bosco, dove formano i Wolverines, un gruppo di resistenza improvvisato determinato a riconquistare la loro città e la loro libertà... e a salvare l'America!

programme.title: Cose Nostre
programme.desc: Fred Blake, alias Giovanni Manzoni, ovvero il pentito più famoso degli Stati Uniti messo sotto protezione dall'FBI, è costretto a trasferirsi con moglie i figli in Normandia per non farsi rintracciare dalla mafia americana. Adattarsi alla nuova vita, però, non è risulta essere così facile...

programme.title: We are your Friends
programme.desc: Cole, un giovane dj, fa la conoscenza del più esperto e famoso collega James Reed, e trova in lui una guida capace di dare una svolta alla sua carriera finora deludente. Contemporaneamente Cole si innamora di Sophie.

programme.title: L'arrivo
programme.desc: Il radioastronomo Zane Zaminsky crede di aver rilevato un rumore cosmico che prova l'esistenza di un'intelligenza extraterrestre. LA sua disperata ricerca di una risposta lo porta a scoprire che gli alieni sono già sulla Terra e che si preparano a conquistarla.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Bloccate a 47 metri di profondità, due sorelle lottano per sopravvivere mentre l'ossigeno si esaurisce e squali bianchi le circondano. La risalita è l'unica speranza, ma ogni movimento potrebbe attirare i predatori. La paura può uccidere prima ancora degli squali.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Un'immersione tra le rovine di una città sommersa si trasforma in un incubo. Quattro amiche sono intrappolate sott'acqua, circondate da squali letali e cunicoli che sembrano stringersi attorno a loro. Sopravvivere richiede sangue freddo… e pura fortuna.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente aereo, cinque amici si ritrovano su una zattera in mezzo al mare, senza cibo né aiuto in vista. Gli squali affamati pattugliano ogni loro mossa, trasformando il mare in una trappola mortale. Sopravvivere sembra impossibile, ma arrendersi non è un'opzione.

programme.title: Ghost stories
programme.desc: Il professor Goodman è un docente di psicologia che non crede ai fenomeni soprannaturali. L'arrivo di una misteriosa lettera che contiene informazioni si tre casi mai risolti lo porterà a imbarcarsi in un viaggio alla scoperta di ciò che non può essere spiegato razionalmente.

programme.title: Una voce nella notte
programme.desc: Uno speaker radiofonico riceve strane telefonate da un ragazzo misterioso. Ma dietro la voce si nasconde un segreto inquietante. Thriller psicologico con Robin Williams.

programme.title: Un Dolce Incontro
programme.desc: Mikayla si occupa di pubbliche relazioni ma non ha fortuna in quelle sentimentali. Quando conosce Austin, proprietario di un bar con il sogno di aprire una pasticceria tutta sua, fa con lui un accordo: assaggerà tutti i suoi dolci in cambio di consigli sentimentali.

programme.title: Amore no-profit
programme.desc: Quando Hayley trova una fede nuziale con una lettera nascosta in un cassetto del suo nuovo condominio, decide di rispondere... e il misterioso amante risponde, iniziando una catena di lettere ed eventi che cambieranno per sempre la sua vita! L'amore esiste, nei posti più inaspettati!

programme.title: Il primo raccolto
programme.desc: Quando Sarah scopre che il vigneto della sua famiglia è in vendita, lascia la sua frenetica vita urbana e visita la sua città natale per aiutare con la vendita e avere il suo ultimo raccolto. Con l'aiuto del bel vicino Gabe, Sarah deve decidere se tornare alla sua vita frenetica o seguire il suo cuore.

programme.title: La mappa dell'amore
programme.desc: Un giornalista in procinto di lanciare un'app di incontri ha il compito di scrivere una mappa dei luoghi più romantici della Florida. L'unico problema è che deve collaborare con una guida turistica i cui gusti sono diametralmente opposti ai suoi.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack, uno sceneggiatore in crisi, incontra per caso Maria, una donna affascinante e superstiziosa che crede fermamente nelle previsioni della sua veggente. Tra rituali, superstizioni e una famiglia invadente, la loro relazione sembra destinata al caos. Eppure, Jack scopre che l'amore può sfidare anche il destino. Ma riusciranno a superare le differenze culturali delle loro famiglie?

programme.title: Principessa cercasi
programme.desc: Un romanziere di romanzi medievali viene assunto come matchmaker per un principe reale in un disperato tentativo di trovare il vero amore prima della data del matrimonio reale fissata.

programme.title: La Combinazione Perfetta
programme.desc: La professionista pianificatrice Gwen si impegna ad aiutare a mettere i tocchi finali al matrimonio della sua migliore amica. Ma quando viene abbinata al testimone Josh, una guida naturalistica, scopre che questo matrimonio potrebbe non essere così facile come pensava.

programme.title: Il Gala dell'Amore
programme.desc: Quando a Kate viene affidato il compito di pianificare la Garden Gala di sua madre, il più grande evento di celebrazione dell'anno, deve scendere a compromessi con il nuovo e contraddittorio manager del giardino botanico.

programme.title: Un amore fuori onda
programme.desc: Savannah viene assunta per riposizionare il conduttore del quarto programma radiofonico di New York. Ma quando finisce accidentalmente in onda con lui, diventa parte del nuovo volto del programma e scopre se a prevalere saranno le loro divergenze in diretta… o l'amore.

programme.title: Ritardare
programme.desc: Proprio mentre la sua vita sta andando a rotoli, una giovane donna vive una terribile tragedia quando il suo ragazzo viene assassinato da un intruso dal quale la donna stessa riesce a malapena a fuggire.

programme.title: Dopo l'uragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012.

programme.title: Elvis & Anabelle
programme.desc: Spinta dalla fanatica madre, Anabelle è il lizza per la vittoria della corona di Miss Texas, quando muore durante il concorso. Finisce così in obitorio, dove lavora Elvis, un imbalsamatore il cui forte amore per il padre malato gli impedisce di coltivare i propri sogni.

programme.title: Il diario dell'amore
programme.desc: Henry e Penny vivono a New Orleans e sono una coppia molto affettuosa, fino a quando la tragedia colpisce.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Tentazioni (ir)resistibili
programme.desc: Una commedia romantica che avvicina tre uomini alle prese con un mondo impegnativo e spesso confusionario, mentre lottano insieme contro un demone comune: la dipendenza dal sesso. Scopriranno che rimanendo uniti potrebbero finalmente avere la loro possibilità di essere felici.

programme.title: Jobs
programme.desc: Interpretato da Ashton Kutcher nel ruolo del co-fondatore di Apple Steve Jobs, il film racconta la vita del giovane, brillante e appassionato imprenditore, la cui genialità ha dato il via alla rivoluzione digitale che ha cambiato per sempre il nostro modo di vivere e comunicare.

programme.title: Born to be Blue
programme.desc: Una rivisitazione del ritnorno musicale della leggenda del jazz Chet Baker alla fine degli anni '60.

programme.title: La porta della Cina
programme.desc: Nel 1954, durante la guerra dell'Indocina francese, una contrabbandiera eurasiatica e un gruppo di mercenari della Legione Straniera francese si infiltrano nel territorio nemico per distruggere un deposito di armi.

programme.title: In fuga per la libertà
programme.desc: Una coppia lascia Budapest a causa del regime, ma è costretta ad abbandonare Suzanne, la figlia minore. Anni dopo, la ragazza si riunisce alla famiglia, ma fatica ad adattarsi negli Stati Uniti. Solo un viaggio in Ungheria le farà riscoprire il vero significato di libertà e casa.

programme.title: Amore on the Road
programme.desc: Quando ABBY riceve un incarico per trasformare un ristorante rustico in un luogo sulla mappa culinaria, è fuori dal suo elemento. Ma mentre ABBY e il proprietario TOM trascorrono del tempo insieme, Abby scopre qualcosa che potrebbe chiamare amore.

programme.title: Un bambino per due
programme.desc: Trovandosi con il bambino di un ammiratore tra le mani, la conduttrice di un programma televisivo mattutino e il suo collega si scoprono innamorati mentre si prendono cura del piccolo insieme.

programme.title: Cucinare con amore
programme.desc: Il programma di cucina per bambini della produttrice televisiva Kelly, "The Little Gourmet", ha un conduttore sostitutivo dell'ultimo minuto, lo chef Stephen dalla testa calda. I due sono in disaccordo, ma si rendono conto di avere molto in comune.

programme.title: Un matrimonio su misura
programme.desc: Cassie, contabile e perfezionista, crede che la sua vita sia perfettamente sulla buona strada, almeno fino a quella di sua madre la wedding planner abbandona e torna nella sua città natale per organizzare l'evento.

programme.title: La perla del paradiso
programme.desc: Una fotografa naturalista in cerca di avventure e un timoroso scrittore di romanzi si ritrovano alle Fiji, coinvolti in una caccia ad una rara perla blu.

programme.title: Incubo in paradiso
programme.desc: Qualche giorno di vacanza in barca con sua figlia, per Samantha si trasforma presto in un incubo.

programme.title: Un guaio di sorella
programme.desc: Klara deve vendere la fattoria e si rivolge alla sorella Mika, che vive nella grande città.

programme.title: Frammenti di follia
programme.desc: La Dott. Dupont inizia un nuovo lavoro in un ospedale psichiatrico. All'improvviso è lei stessa una paziente.

programme.title: Live is life. 80... e tanta voglia di rock
programme.desc: Un musicista condannato a lavorare in una casa di riposo decide di formare un gruppo rock con gli anziani.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: The Artist
programme.desc: Un divo del muto cade in disgrazia con l'invenzione del sonoro. Verrà salvato dall'amore di una sua fan.L'evento in bianco e nero che ha conquistato Cannes.

programme.title: Ladre per caso
programme.desc: L'introversa Carole e la ribelle Caroline hanno in comune solo il padre Patrick, un ladro internazionale ricercato ovunque. Intenzionato a rubare uno «stradivari», Patrick chiederà aiuto alle due figlie, tentando di recuperare il tempo perduto.

programme.title: Biuti Quin Olivia
programme.desc: Nei primi anni ottanta in una periferia di Roma cresce Olivia, una ragazza con un carattere difficile e ribelle rovinata da una situazione familiare difficile. La madre cameriera viene licenziata e il padre è un invalido civile violento e volgare. A scuola incontra una ragazza, Lili, con la quale litiga spesso. Quel che sembrava una rivalità ostile, diventerà invece una solida amicizia. Lili organizza a scuola un concorso chiamato appunto Biuti Quin Olivia alla quale partecipa volentieri anche Olivia.I genitori però non vogliono. Infine le due amiche cercheranno il vero padre di Olivia.

programme.title: La Comune
programme.desc: Erik e Anna, con la figlia Freja, creano una comune nella villa di famiglia a Copenhagen. Tra amicizie, feste e sogni condivisi, l'equilibrio viene spezzato da una relazione inaspettata che metterà alla prova il legame tra i membri della comunità.

programme.title: Mrs. Mills
programme.desc: Helene possiede un appartamento chic nel centro di Parigi, pubblica romanzi romanticamente kitsch e conduce una vita completamente dettata dal lavoro. Tutto il suo amore è per i libri. Ma la sua vita quotidiana viene stravolta quando la signora Mills, un'eccentrica signora americana, si trasferisce nell'appartamento accanto.

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: Friends with Money
programme.desc: Il film esamina i mutevoli rapporti tra quattro donne la cui amicizia di lunga data è minacciata dalla crescente disparità del loro stato finanziario. Le tre amiche ricche, Frannie, Jane e Christine, condividono una preoccupazione per Olivia, che sembra incapace di guadagnarsi da vivere o di portare avanti una relazione, almeno per i loro standard.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Una quasi trentenne frustrata da un impiego temporaneo come segretaria si sfida da sola ai fornelli: dovrà preparare tutte le 524 ricette del manuale di cucina di Julia Child in un anno. E racconta le sue tribolazioni in un blog che conquista gli amanti del cibo.

programme.title: As Good as It Gets
programme.desc: Melvin odia le donne, i gay ed è pieno di manie. Ma qualcosa è destinato a cambiare. C'era una volta, un misogino, ossessionato da una serie infinita di complessi e manie e dotato di una lingua avvelenata. Ma dopo l'incontro con un cane e con una bella cameriera, qualcosa cambia e l'orco si rivela un burbero benefico.

programme.title: Il casinista
programme.desc: Il comico Marullo spinge l'amico Casciotta a scrivere storie reali, scatenando una serie di disavventure.

programme.title: Riuscirà l'avvocato Franco Benenato a sconfiggere il suo acerrimo nemico il pretore Ciccio De Ingras?
programme.desc: Il pretore Ciccio, stanco dell'avv. Benenato, dopo il trasferimento di questi, si sente meglio finché a Milano non trova una sorpresa

programme.title: Le piacevoli notti di Justine
programme.desc: Nell'Ottocento, due attori girovaghi aprono un locale equivoco, sfidano il governatore

programme.title: Il ras del quartiere
programme.desc: Domingo, capo di teppisti e custodi del quartiere, aiuta un uomo a cercare la figlia scappata di casa

programme.title: Se permetti non parlarmi di bambini!
programme.desc: Da quando si è separato, Gabriel non ha fatto altro che dedicarsi a sua figlia Sofia. Un giorno si presenta al suo negozio di musica Vicky, una donna del passato, oggi più affascinante che mai. A lei però i bambini non piacciono affatto.

programme.title: Piacere Dave
programme.desc: Dave Ming Chang (Eddie Murphy) è proprio un pesce fuor d'acqua. Per forza: non è affatto un uomo, ma una nave spaziale fatta a immagine del suo capitano in miniatura.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fan di Star Wars raggiunge lo Skywalker Ranch per rubare una copia di "The Phantom Menace," così che il loro amico, un malato terminale, possa vederlo prima che esca al cinema.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Moonwalkers
programme.desc: 1969: il governo americano ha bisogno delle riprese di un falso allunaggio per battere sul tempo i russi e manda a Londra un agente della CIA traumatizzato dal Vietnam perché convinca Kubrick a girarlo.

programme.title: Gatto nero, gatto bianco
programme.desc: Due giovani si vogliono bene, ma le loro famiglie si oppongono. È solo il pretesto per tutto il resto di questo film unico. Il Kusturica più vero, e Leone d'Argento a Venezia

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Lillo e Greg: The Movie
programme.desc: Una collezione antologica delle migliori scenette comiche firmate da Lillo e Greg, in compagnia di tanti famosi colleghi. Un concentrato di ironia e musica dai tratti surreali e farseschi.

programme.title: Maciste contro lo sceicco
programme.desc: Nel deserto tra insidie e duelli, Maciste affronta uno sceicco crudele per liberare prigionieri e salvare il regno.

programme.title: Maciste gladiatore di Sparta
programme.desc: Tra arene, rivolte e battaglie spettacolari, Maciste sfida il potere per liberare gli oppressi e cambiare il destino di Sparta

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Sandokan alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: Sandokan contro il leopardo di Sarawak
programme.desc: Tra giungle e mari esotici, Sandokan sfida il temibile Leopardo di Sarawak in una lotta tra vendetta e libertà, tra duelli e battaglie spettacolari.

programme.title: La morte non conta i dollari
programme.desc: Lawrence White torna nella città di Owell Rock per vendicare l'omicidio di suo padre, ma per portare a termine i suoi piani cambia nome e fa in modo che un altro uomo si atteggi a "Lawrence White".

programme.title: Texas, addio
programme.desc: Uno sceriffo texano e suo fratello minore attraversano il confine con il Messico per affrontare l'uomo che ha ucciso il loro padre.

programme.title: Dio in cielo... Arizona in terra
programme.desc: Arizona, cacciatore di taglie, interviene per aiutare contadini oppressi contro il potente Austin Styles e la sua banda di fuorilegge. Tra inganni e pericoli, diventa il loro unico alleato nella lotta per proteggere le terre e la vita.

programme.title: Quel maledetto giorno d'inverno... Django e Sartana all'ultimo sangue
programme.desc: Incastrato per una rapina in banca, il fratello del bounty killer Django, Steve viene linciato. Django dà la caccia a Sartana, il presunto complice di Steve, ma trova anche lui innocente. I due uomini cercano i veri ladri.

programme.title: ...e poi lo chiamarono il Magnifico
programme.desc: Joe, che non ama la violenza, affronta il selvaggio West per esaudire l'ultimo desiderio del padre.

programme.title: Lo credevano uno stinco di santo
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fuorilegge sono in cerca del tesoro nascosto di un vecchio prigioniero: solo uno lo troverà

programme.title: Sette ore di fuoco
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill guida una carovana di pionieri e affronta una banda di contrabbandieri che vende armi ai Sioux.

programme.title: La resa dei conti
programme.desc: Il cacciatore di taglie Jonathan Corbett è stato assunto per catturare un giovane messicano accusato di stupro.

programme.title: Stelle del Grande Schermo
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.8
programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: Trigger Point
programme.desc: Quando i suoi ex colleghi dei servizi segreti sono misteriosamente uccisi, Shaw deve tornare in azione.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.8

programme.desc: David Bowie ha segnato profondamente la musica rock: il documentario ci lascia un ritratto della sua carriera.
